learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how special our names are and how to spell them!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: You, your friends, and your teachers all have special names.
Our names are made of letters from the alphabet joined together.
When we meet someone new, we say 'Hello' and tell them our name.

fun_activity.title: ✨ Name Tag Maker
fun_activity.instructions: Write your name in big letters on a piece of cardboard. Decorate it with stars and colors to wear as a badge!

quick_recap: ⭐ Every person has a beautiful name.
⭐ Names are made up of alphabet letters.
⭐ We share our names to make new friends.
